with t_6 as (SELECT `t2`.`total_assets`, `t2`.`stock_name`, `t2`.`total_equity`, `t3`.`net_profit`, `t3`.`total_profit`, `t2`.`stock_code`
FROM
(SELECT `stock_code`, `stock_name`, `report_date`, `total_assets`, `total_liabilities`, `total_equity`, `current_assets`, `current_liabilities`, `non_current_assets`, `non_current_liabilities`
FROM
`balance_sheet`) AS `t2`
INNER JOIN (SELECT `stock_code`, `stock_name`, `report_date`, `revenue`, `operating_cost`, `operating_profit`, `total_profit`, `net_profit`, `parent_net_profit`, `basic_eps`
FROM
`income_stmt`) AS `t3` ON `t2`.`stock_code` = `t3`.`stock_code` AND `t2`.`report_date` = `t3`.`report_date`)
SELECT stock_name, stock_code, SUM(total_equity) AS total_equity, SUM(total_assets) AS total_assets, SUM(total_profit) AS total_profit, SUM(net_profit) AS net_profit FROM t_6 GROUP BY stock_name, stock_code LIMIT 200 OFFSET 0

with t_6 as (SELECT `total_assets`, `current_liabilities`, `total_liabilities`, `total_equity`, `current_assets`
FROM
`balance_sheet`)
SELECT SUM(total_equity) AS total_equity, SUM(total_liabilities) AS total_liabilities, SUM(total_assets) AS total_assets, SUM(current_liabilities) AS current_liabilities, SUM(current_assets) AS current_assets FROM t_6 LIMIT 200 OFFSET 0

with t_6 as (SELECT `total_assets`, `stock_name`
FROM
`balance_sheet`)
SELECT stock_name, SUM(total_assets) AS total_assets FROM t_6 GROUP BY stock_name LIMIT 200 OFFSET 0

with t_6 as (SELECT `total_assets`, `stock_name`
FROM
`balance_sheet`)
SELECT stock_name, SUM(total_assets) AS total_assets FROM t_6 GROUP BY stock_name LIMIT 200 OFFSET 0

with t_6 as (SELECT `stock_name`, `net_profit`
FROM
`income_stmt`)
SELECT stock_name, SUM(net_profit) AS net_profit FROM t_6 GROUP BY stock_name ORDER BY SUM(net_profit) DESC LIMIT 200 OFFSET 0
